verdict.rationale: Windmill is a developer platform with an HTTP API, so a downloadable OpenAPI spec is a fair question. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of a published API spec, and the probe found 404s at every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path on windmill.dev. The llms.txt file, the markdown docs, the CLI and the MCP server are related agent-facing features but are not a machine-readable API specification, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
